verdict.rationale: Raygun is an error- and performance-monitoring SaaS, so scheduled recurring reports, checks or workflows are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no capability for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. The closest items are adjacent rather than relevant: 'ignore for a specific time period' is a status condition, and time-range export is a one-off manual action, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
